notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Orzhov Basilica.
Orzhov Basilica does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Orzhov Basilica.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Orzhov Basilica to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Orzhov Basilica.
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Orzhov Basilica.
Repeat.
